narrative:
Workforce planning covers almost 18,000 FTE — 61% of them clinical: dentists, doctors, nurses, carers and dental nurses — with a fully loaded people cost of about GBP 800M a year.

Care Services and Dental Care are the most labour-intensive units. Agency staffing runs at 11.8% of clinical hours against a 9% target, and dental nurse roles take more than 50 days to fill in London & South East. Clinics & Hospitals adds clinical capacity as King Edward VII and New Victoria hospitals ramp up theatre and diagnostic sessions.

Blended attrition is planned at about 16%; first-year leavers in care homes and dental practices are the main driver.

signals.title: UK Care Services occupancy up to 92%
signals.excerpt: UK Care Services grew revenue and underlying profit through increasing occupancy to 92% (HY25: 90%) and disciplined cost management.

signals.title: King Edward VII and New Victoria hospitals join UK Health Services
signals.excerpt: UK Health Services revenue grew on higher volumes and the two acquisitions; underlying profit reduced as Bupa invests for growth.
